يخترعون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَرِعُونَ (yaḵtariʕūna) /jax.ta.ri.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# يُخْتَرَعُونَ (yuḵtaraʕūna) /jux.ta.ra.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
